name: Volumetric Photon Mapping
aliases: Real-time volume rendering for three-dimensional fetal ultrasound using volumetric photon mapping
Volumetric Photon Mapping (VPM) for Fetal Ultrasound
Volumetric Photon Mapping (VPM) for Real-Time Fetal Ultrasound
Volumetric photon mapping with screen-space destiny estimation
definition: An algorithm for creating a photon map within participating media by ray marching from light sources through the volume to store photon interactions.
summary: Volumetric Photon Mapping is a global illumination technique for participating media that uses a 3D volume texture and screen-space estimation to enable real-time, artifact-free rendering of light transport in medical imaging.
